name: Renzik "The Shiv"
summary: In Stormwind's Old Town, Renzik "The Shiv" directs SI:7's new rogue recruits. The goblin is Spymaster Mathias Shaw's trusted second-in-command, receiving promising agents sent from across the Alliance.

sections.title: A Goblin in SI:7
sections.body: Renzik keeps his past to himself. In Stormwind, he is known as a goblin who rose to become Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second-in-command in SI:7. He has little patience for pleasantries. When new recruits arrive, he asks whether they are ready to work or need a nap first.

sections.title: Right Hand of Mathias Shaw
sections.body: Renzik works inside SI:7's secretive fortress in Old Town, second-in-command to Mathias Shaw. Rogue mentors across the Alliance, from Ironforge to Darnassus, send their most promising agents to him. He sends them to field instructors such as Lucius in Redridge, where they can hone the skills needed to survive in the field.

faq.q: Why is a goblin working for Stormwind's SI:7?
aliases: why is there a goblin in si7
faq.answer: Renzik keeps the story of how he came to Stormwind to himself. The goblin has risen to become Mathias Shaw's second-in-command at SI:7.
Renzik has never told Stormwind how he got his nickname. In Old Town, the name is all anyone gets, and for a spy that may be the point.

faq.q: What does Renzik do for player rogues?
faq.answer: When Alliance rogues prove their skill, their trainers send them to Renzik in Stormwind. He handles their entry into SI:7 and sends recruits to instructors such as Lucius in the Redridge Mountains to learn how to survive in the field.
Renzik is stationed inside SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, Stormwind City, where Alliance rogue recruits report to him.

faq.q: Does Renzik maintain ties outside Stormwind?
faq.answer: Yes. Rogue trainers in Ironforge and Darnassus send promising students to Renzik, who passes recruits on to Lucius, an SI:7 associate in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: As an Alliance rogue, you pass through Renzik's hands on your way from street-level knifework into SI:7. He sends recruits to Lucius in Redridge to learn fieldcraft and survive.
Though he is a goblin, Renzik is one of Stormwind's most capable intelligence officers, second only to Mathias Shaw within SI:7.
Beside Spymaster Shaw in Old Town, Renzik is a rare goblin in the kingdom's military elite. His place there shows that loyalty and skill matter in the shadow wars.
